title: Delayed trip, identified driver matches the one already assigned
description: Same shape as O3.1 (identification delivered live, at deliverAtSec 0, before any trip exists; the trip's own frames then arrive as a full burst starting at burstStartAtSec 20), but the scenario sets up the asset's standing assignee as driver A beforehand, matching the identification's own driver. One HARDBRAKE at atSec 30, before the identification's claimed atSec 70, so it is a violation raised while the driver was still unknown -- this is the violation the `noTransfers: true` assertion depends on. Must prove: the trip's own assignee is still genuinely written, from null to A, because the trip-driver guard has no memory of the asset's value; no threshold transfer occurs. Must NOT change: because the asset assignee is already A, resulted_in_assignee_change must be false and no new asset-assignee write or audit entry may be recorded.

events.note: violation while the driver is still unknown; noTransfers depends on this

driver_identifications.note: on the wire 20 seconds before the trip that contains it; same driver as the asset's pre-existing standing assignee
